author: Codex
finding: The approved leading-dash target is recognized as a filename, but solc 0.4.12 rejects an existing sibling import inside the project with --allow-paths .

proposal.behavior: Use the resolved absolute project root as --allow-paths for both project solc argv and Slither solc_args. Preserve the leading-dash ./ target, exact source bytes, candidate order, settings, D3 and binding gate. The physical allowed root remains the same project root.
proposal.tests: Keep all eight existing assertions/fixtures; add four-version ordinary nested-entry/sibling-import checks. Run the twelve checks once, stop on first failure; never move the dependency to hide the failing import.
proposal.revalidation: Only after all twelve pass, revalidate the union of 11 previously approved leading-dash units and 92 units with this observed diagnostic, including 79 prior successes because their selected versions may change. Replace exactly these 103 rows in a new summary; preserve every old result and all other observations.

basis: PROMPTS 4.5 section 2 requires stop/report on incompatible parameters; 4.1 forbids automatic retries or unapproved design changes. Original approval only changed the entry target and allowed eleven corpus units.
not_yet_proven: An absolute root resolving the issue across the four compiler versions is a proposed correction, not an observed success.
known_scope_limit: Read-only impact list uses the specific observed allowed-directory diagnostic; no claim that every possible filesystem loader limitation is covered.
